description: Demo and test of the NPC needs system: five office staff get hungry, thirsty, tired and bored, queue for coffee, go back to their own desks, and tidy or open items the player drops. Nothing to solve.
test_objective: Watch every needs feature happen within a few minutes: six need types, contention for one coffee station, return to own desk, carry and use of dropped items, conversation freeze, yield to player, npc_used events on a whiteboard and the objectives list
